value.rationale: Natural Lie bracket [E,F] of primitive idempotents in full finite matrix rings; a full similarity-type distribution for every q and n is a substantive complete invariant, not a single arbitrary numerical instance. Characteristic-sensitive companion strata and the explicitly positive asymptotic J3 nilpotent fraction carry information unavailable from marginal product ranks or the cubic relation alone. The output supports structural and probabilistic study of noncommutativity of primitive projections.
